fields.why: Methods compare subgroup estimates with a designated referent by z-tests; Table 2 compares 7 race/ethnicity groups with White, and the text compares 3 insurance and 3 MSA groups with their referents.
Race/ethnicity (7 groups), insurance (private, Medicaid/other nonprivate, uninsured: SES) and MSA status (3 levels: rurality) qualify; poverty is 2 groups and jurisdiction is geography.
Every subgroup contrast is a z-test against a designated referent group ('Statistically significant ... compared with the referent group'); no omnibus or trend test.
